summary: Comprehensive test of new cloud-sync architecture (FastAPI + MongoDB + JWT). All 11 backend pytest cases passed (auth, vendors, bills, payments, snapshot). Frontend E2E validated: admin login stores 231-char JWT in ae_vm_jwt, syncFromCloud auto-pulls snapshot, UI vendor create fires POST /api/vendors, and cross-device simulation (clear localStorage + re-login) successfully pulls back the newly created vendor from cloud. Cross-device data sync is confirmed working.

minor.issue: POST does not enforce id uniqueness at DB write with meaningful error — depends on client to send 'id'. 400 returned if id missing, which is fine.
allow_origins is '*' from env with allow_credentials=False. Acceptable for JWT-in-header auth, but if cookies are ever adopted, must explicit-list origins.

issues: Clean UI, 'Cloud Synced' badge is a nice touch; no admin hint leak — confirmed.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider rate-limiting /api/auth/login to mitigate brute force (playbook suggests 5-fail lockout).
OPTIONAL: Add /api/auth/register self-registration guard (currently anyone can register as User; role=Admin request downgraded to User which is correct).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: seed_admin re-hashes and updates password on every startup — this is idempotent but means changing ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env will overwrite on restart (by design, matches playbook).
server.py: /api/payments/bulk fully replaces collection — this is intentional per client contract but could cause data loss if two devices race. Acceptable for current use.
server.py: All CRUD endpoints share a single 'user' auth scope — no per-user data isolation. Since this is a single-tenant admin app, acceptable, but should be documented.
auth_utils.py: JWT_SECRET is loaded from env — good. Ensure it never falls back to a default.
test_credentials: ashishsrivastava085@gmail.com / admin@123 (Admin) — verified working via both API and UI
seed_data_creation: Test run created ephemeral vendor 'CrossDev_UI_<timestamp>' + 'Cloud Test Vendor' remained from prior curl seeding. Backend tests use TEST_ prefix and clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at /api with JWT auth is live. Token key: ae_vm_jwt. Login endpoint expects {identifier, password}. All CRUD endpoints require Bearer. Snapshot GET/POST used for bulk sync. Frontend Login uses data-testid='login-submit', vendor form fields use data-testid='field-<name>' (e.g. field-firmName, field-mobileNo). Save button: data-testid='btn-save', New: btn-new.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Cross-device sync validated end-to-end: create in session A → clear localStorage → re-login → vendor reappears from cloud.
